fields.description: Use Sandbox with test credentials, Production with live credentials.
fields.label: Environment

fields.options:
Find the Merchant Key and Salt in the PayU dashboard under Developers → API Keys (switch the dashboard to test mode for the Sandbox keys). Use the salt version 1 ("Salt").

Saving checks the keys with PayU and creates the PayU Payment Gateway Account for your default company.

fields.description: PayU needs a mobile number for every payment. This number is used when the customer has none (Payment Request, contact on the order or invoice, or Customer).
fields.label: Fallback Customer Mobile

fields.description: On the customer's order page of the Webshop, Pay opens the PayU checkout, even when the Webshop checkout uses another gateway (e.g. Cash on Delivery).
fields.label: Use PayU for the Webshop Pay Button

fields.options: In the PayU dashboard under Developers → Webhooks, add the Payment Webhook URL for the Successful and Failed payment events, and the Refund Webhook URL for the Refund event. PayU must reach your site over HTTPS. Without webhooks, payments are still checked when the customer returns and every 15 minutes.
